opening.argument: The presentation features Canadian women entrepreneurs sharing their experiences and advice for aspiring business owners, including an account of opening a first restaurant at age 53. Its discussion of teaching how business is run and of mentoring and networking supports an educational, encouraging message. The $117 billion figure is presented as an economic-activity statistic, not a promised investment return, guaranteed income, or condition of participation. The closing RBC branding reinforces support for women entrepreneurs; nothing in these cited accounts turns that support into a promised financial outcome.

citations.quote: We asked successful Canadian female entrepreneurs to share their stories and offer advice on how to support aspiring female business owners get ahead.
At the age of 53 years old I decided to go in a new venture and open my first restaurant.
Take them into the boardroom to teach them how business is run.
I see so many more invitations for mentoring and network conversations in the past few years than I've had in my entire career.
